target: 779 Piratarum Portus

source: 779 Pirate Haven
target: 779 Piratarum Portus

source: Banamo Port.
target: Portus Banamo.

source: As Lumian strolled along the streets, he couldn’t shake the feeling that he had arrived in Backlund, the capital of the Loen Kingdom.
target: Dum Lumian per vias vagabatur, sensum vix removit se advenisse in Backlund, caput regni Loen.

source: Although he had never been there, the foggy sky and damp, cold environment mirrored Trier’s newspapers and magazines’ mockery of Backlund.
target: Quamquam numquam ibi fuerat, caelum nebulosum atque ambitus humidus ac frigidus repraesentabant derisionem Backlund, qualem diurnaria et ephemerides Trierenses ostenderunt.

source: Of course, the architectural style here was distinctly different from Backlund’s.
target: Scilicet, stilus architectonicus hic clare differens erat ab illo Backlund.

source: There were two main types: one was large yet not crude, with typical Feysac characteristics, and the other was a mix of stone and wood, simple and rough, often crowded together without any clear planning.
target: Duo genera praecipua erant: unum, magnum sed non rudis, notis propriis Feysac, et alterum, mixtio lapidis atque ligni, simplex ac asper, quæ saepe sine apparente consilio coniungebatur.

source: Most of the people on the streets were dressed like typical pirates, with short knives strapped to their waists and guns tucked into their belts, not bothering to conceal their weapons.
target: Plurimi homines in viis, ut piratae consueti, induti erant, cum cultrellis brevis ad lumbos alligatis atque tormentis in cingulis reconditis, qui arma celare non curabant.

source: In contrast, the locals with dark-brown skin always wore smiles, their faces full of deference.
target: Contra, incolae cum cute fusca constanter subridens erant, vultus reverentia impleti.

source: Lumian fully understood the mindset of the natives.
target: Lumian rationem incolarum plene intellexit.

source: After all, angering a pirate could result in being dragged into a corner and killed, or having someone sneak into their home at night to murder them.
target: Nam, si aliquem piratam irasceres, id efficere poterat ut in angulum traheretur atque interficeretur, aut ut quis in nocte in domum eorum insidiareretur ad caedem.

source: The killer would then sail away on their pirate ship without a care.
target: Interfector postea in sua nave piratica navigabat, nec curas habens.

source: The current rulers of Banamo Island were trying to recruit pirates and adventurers to maintain order and hoped the great pirates would agree on a pirate code to regulate behavior in the port.
target: Rectores actuales insulae Banamo conabantur piratas et viatores ad ordinem conservandum congregare, atque sperabant magnos piratas consensuros esse in codice piratico qui mores in portu regeret.

source: However, these measures had limited effectiveness.
target: Attamen hae mensurae efficacitatem limitatam habebant.

source: This was because seasoned pirates couldn’t suddenly start obeying laws and strict rules, even if they became sheriffs or police officers.
target: Id est, piratae periti repente legibus et normis severis obtemperare non poterant, etiam si praefecti vel custodes facti essent.

source: Moreover, there wasn’t a strong enough force on the island to keep them in check.
target: Porro, non exstabat vis satis valida in insula ad eos continendos.

source: As a result, it was common for sheriffs to break the law and accept bribes to shield criminals.
target: Ex hoc erat commune ut praefecti leges transgrederentur et munera acciperent ad scelestes defendendos.

source: The pirate code, agreed upon by the great pirates, wasn’t mandatory.
target: Codex piraticus, ab ingentibus piratis conveniens, non obligatorius erat.

source: Even if someone broke it, they would only face minor punishment within their own crew.
target: Etiam si quis codicem fregisset, tantum minimum poenam intra propriam turmam affligeret.

source: No one would hand over their own men to be dealt with by others.
target: Nemo proprios suos tradiret ut ab aliis punirentur.

source: These measures’ greatest effect was making Banamo Port appear somewhat orderly.
target: Earum mensurarum potentissimum effectus erat ut Portus Banamo aliquatenus ordinatus videbatur.

source: As Lumian admired the bustling street scenes, he occasionally heard screams or gunshots from the alleys.
target: Dum Lumian plateas animatas admirabatur, interdum clamores aut ictus sclopetorum ex angustiis audiebat.

source: This place is perfect for a Hunter, he thought, genuinely appreciating it.
target: Hic locus perfectus est pro Venatore, existimavit, vere eum laudans.

source: When two groups of pirates started a brawl in the middle of the street, Lumian had a sudden idea: A large-scale plague for a Demoness of Despair advancement ritual could work here…
target: Duo coetus piratorum in media platea pugnam incipientes, Lumian subito ideam cepit: pestilentia in scala magna ad ritum progressionis Demonissae Desperationis hic efficax esse posset…

source: But I would need to develop medicine to prevent infection or severe illness and secretly distribute it to the locals…
target: Sed medicinam conficiendam mihi erit, ut infectionem vel grave morbum prohibeas, atque eam incolis occulto modo distribuam…

source: The only problem is that there aren’t 30,000 pirates here.
target: Solum problema est, hic non esse triginta milia piratorum.

source: However, there are quite a few Beyonders among them.
target: Attamen inter eos nonnulli Beyonders sunt.

source: Infecting them and causing them suffering and despair should significantly reduce the number needed for the ritual…
target: Eos inficiendo atque cruciando cum desperatione, numerum ad ritum requisitum significativo modo minuere debet…

source: As Lumian watched the pirate brawl with interest, he pondered the feasibility of holding the Demoness of Despair ritual in Banamo Port.
target: Dum Lumian pugnam piraticam cum curiositate spectabat, de possibilitate ritus Demonissae Desperationis in Portu Banamo celebrandi meditabatur.

source: When the fight was almost over, the sheriffs finally arrived, dispersing the two groups and symbolically arresting a few people.
target: Cum pugna paene finita esset, praefecti tandem advenerunt, duo coetus dissipantes et paucos homines symbolice arripientes.

source: They were just waiting for the respective pirate crews to pay the fines!
target: Tantum exspectabant ut singuli coetus piratorum multa solverent!

source: As for the grievances between the two groups, the sheriffs didn’t care.
target: Quod attinet ad querimonias inter hos duo coetus, custodes nihil curabant.

source: If they wanted revenge, they would have to settle it out at sea.
target: Si vindictam optabant, eam in mari componere necesse habebant.

source: Meanwhile, adventurers and locals quietly dragged away some of the pirate corpses left on the street.
target: Interim, viatores et incolae tacite aliquot cadavera piratorum via relicta abstulerunt.

source: Lumian felt like applauding this kind of order.
target: Lumian huic ordini plausum dare vellet.

source: Taking advantage of the remaining daylight and the sun filtering through the fog, he continued his leisurely stroll through Banamo Port.
target: Ut luce residua et sole per nebulam transfigurante uti posset, iter leviter per Portum Banamo continuavit.

source: Passing a stone house with a small square, he saw a dozen or so people gathered, mostly locals.
target: Transiens domum lapideam cum parvo atrio, vidit circiter duodecim homines congregatos, plerumque incolas.

source: A pirate wearing a bicorne hat and blue woolen clothes stood on a stone platform in front of them.
target: Pirata, galea bicornata gerens et vestimenta lanae caeruleae indutus, in suggestu lapideo coram illis stetit.

source: The pirate was shouting in Feysac, “You’re just a bunch of pups fresh from your mother’s embrace.
target: Pirata Feysace clamabat: “Vos estis tantum catuli recens ex amplexu matris.

source: If you want to become proper pirates, you need training.
target: Si vultis piratae veraces fieri, exercitatione opus est vobis.

source: Today, I’ll give you your first lesson: who you can and can’t mess with at sea…
target: Hodie, primam lectionem vobis dabo: de his, quibus in mari agere licet et quibus non…

source: Feysac was the language with the least difference from ancient Feysac.
target: Lingua Feysac erat, quae parum ab antiquo Feysac differre videbatur.

source: Lumian, skilled in ancient Feysac, barely understood what the pirate was saying.
target: Lumian, in antiquo Feysac peritus, vix intellexit quid pirata dicebat.

source: He realized that the pirate crew was recruiting newcomers and providing basic training.
target: Animadvertit coetum piratarum novos recrutarentur atque disciplinam primariam praebere.

source: Why does this feel like a big company in Trier hiring new employees…
target: Cur hoc videtur quasi magna societas Trierensis novas operarias conducere…

source: Lumian grumbled to himself as he watched the pirate display wanted posters and portraits, introducing the six kings, nine admirals, and notable adventurers.
target: Lumian sibi murmuravit dum spectabat piratas tabulas quaesitas et imagines ostendentes, inter quos sex reges, novem admirales atque notos viatores introducere videbantur.

source: This was exactly the information Lumian needed.
target: Hoc erat prorsus informatio quam Lumian desiderabat.

source: He stopped and listened from a distance.
target: Consedit et a longe audivit.

source: As expected, he saw a portrait and detailed introduction of Louis Berry.
target: Ut expectabatur, imaginem atque enarrationem de Ludovico Berry perspexit.

source: At the end, the pirate with the bicorne hat pointed to a portrait and said, “His bounty isn’t high, but you must never underestimate him, or even have any contact with him.”
target: Ad finem, pirata galea bicornata gerens ad imaginem monstravit et dixit: “Praemium eius non magnum est, sed numquam debetis eum subestimare, neque ullam transactionem cum eo habere.”

source: No contact at all?
target: Nullum commercium omnino?

source: Lumian focused on the portrait, seeing a burly man in his thirties with thick brown body hair, wearing suspenders and a white shirt.
target: Lumian imaginem contemplatus est, videns virum robustum, circa tricesimum annos natus, densis pilis fuscae corporis, sustentamenta gerens atque tunicam albanam indutum.

source: The pirate’s tone became serious as he introduced the man to the new pirates, “His name is Frank Lee, the first mate of the Queen of Stars.
target: Tonus piratae serio factus est, dum virum novis piratis introducere inceperet, “Nomen eius est Frank Lee, primus minister navis Reginae Stellarum.

source: He's a Druid.
target: Druidus est.

source: What is a Druid?
target: Quid est druida?

source: I’ll explain when we cover Beyonder knowledge.
target: Explicabo, cum de cognitione Beyonder agemus.

source: For now, just know that a Druid is Sequence 5, on par with the Pirate Admirals.
target: Modo scito, druida est Series V, pariter cum Admiralibus Piraticis.

source: So, understand how terrifying Frank Lee is?
target: Ergo, intellegite quam terribilis sit Frank Lee?

source: But that's not the main reason adventurers and pirates fear him.
target: Sed hoc non est principale quod viatores et piratae eum timent.

source: I don't know the exact reason either.
target: Nec ego certam causam scio.

source: I only know that every pirate and adventurer who’s encountered Frank Lee acts like they’ve gone mad.
target: Scio tantum quod omnis pirata atque viator, qui Frank Lee occurrit, agitur quasi insaniti affectus sit.

source: They jump out of their chairs and sometimes vomit when his name is mentioned.
target: Ex sellis desilire et interdum vomere incipiunt, cum nomen eius dicitur.

source: They always warn me to stay away from Frank Lee and not to leave any blood near him or eat anything found around him…
target: Semper me admonent ut a Frank Lee recedam, neque sanguinem prope eum relinquam aut quidquid circa eum reperitur edam…

source: So, the legendary Druid Frank Lee is the first mate of the Pirate King…
target: Ita, legendarius druida Frank Lee est primus minister regis piratarum…

source: But why are so many pirates and adventurers so terrified of him?
target: At cur tot piratae et viatores eum ita territi sint?

source: Even if he has the strength of a Pirate Admiral and is ruthless, it shouldn’t cause this reaction…
target: Etiamsi roboris Admiralis Piratici et crudelitatis ei haberet, haec responsio non oriri debet…

source: Lumian silently mused as he listened to the pirate’s introduction.
target: Lumian tacite cogitabat, dum piratae introductionem audiebat.

source: He was curious about what made Frank Lee so special.
target: Curiosus erat quid specialem faceret Frank Lee.

source: After watching the pirate crew’s recruitment, Lumian headed to the nearby Carnival Bar.
target: Postquam coetum piratarum novos recrutarentur vidit, Lumian ad tabernam “Carnival Bar” proximam se contulit.

source: He pushed through the unapologetically pirate crowd and sat on a high stool at the bar, ordering a Lanti Proof.
target: Per turbas piratarum impune institorum propulsus, in subsello alto ad tabernam sedit et iussit “Lanti Proof.”

source: The common language in Banamo Port was Feysac, but pirates spoke various languages, and few were multilingual.
target: Lingua communis in Portu Banamo erat Feysac, sed piratae varias linguas loquebantur, et parvi erant qui plures linguis utebantur.

source: Those who spoke Feysac formed one circle, those who spoke Intisian another, and so on.
target: Qui Feysac loquebantur, circulum unum formabant; qui Intisian, alium; et cetera.

source: Lumian chose the Carnival Bar because all its signage was in Intisian.
target: Lumian “Carnival Bar” eligere curavit, quod omnia insignia eius in Intisian posita erant.

source: In the noisy, lively environment, Lumian took two sips of his drink, put down his glass, and asked the bartender loudly in Intisian, “Do you have detailed information on the nine Pirate Admirals?”
target: In tumultuoso et vivo ambitu, Lumian duo sorbos poculi suae cepit, vitrum deponens, et tabernario voce alta in Intisian rogavit: “Habesne informationem accuratam de novem Admiralibus Piraticis?”

source: Something beyond the wanted posters.
target: Aliquid ultra tabulas quaesitas.

source: Suddenly, the entire bar went silent.
target: Subito, tota taberna silentio cecidit.

source: Every pirate turned to look at Lumian at the bar.
target: Omnis pirata in taberna ad Lumian se convertere coepit.

source: It became so quiet that the sound of someone swallowing could be heard.
target: Ita silentium fuit ut sonus aliquis deglutitionis audiri posset.

source: The bartender’s expression turned awkward and amused.
target: Vultus tabernarii incommodus ac hilaris factus est.

source: He asked Lumian, “Are you an adventurer?”
target: Rogavit Lumian: “Esne viator?”

source: An adventurer coming to a pirate bar to ask for detailed information on the Pirate Admirals!
target: Viator ad tabernam piraticam accessurus est ut informationem accuratam de Admiralibus Piraticis peteret!

source: Lumian didn’t answer the bartender.
target: Lumian tabernario nihil respondit.

source: He half-turned to look at the staring pirates.
target: Lumian semiconversus ad piratas qui eum intuebantur aspiciebat.

source: Around him, one by one, crimson-white fireballs began to form and float in the air.
target: Circa eum, uno post alium, globuli ignis rubro-albo formari atque in aere fluitare coeperunt.

source: Lumian smiled, raising his chin slightly.
target: Lumian subridens leviter mentum suum extulit.

source: “Even though your bounties are low and I don’t want to bother, if anyone wants to give me money voluntarily, I won’t mind accepting it.”
target: “Etiamsi praemia vestra parva sunt et nolo vos sollicitare, si quis mihi libere pecuniam dare velit, eam accipere non negabo.”

source: The pirates’ expressions changed, but Lumian’s gaze remained steady.
target: Vultus piratorum mutati sunt, sed aspectus Lumiani stabilis manebat.

source: He scanned their faces and sneered.
target: Eorum vultus perlegens, irridere constituit.

source: “Anyone want to try?”
target: “Num quis conari velit?”

source: Silence.
target: Silentium.

source: The entire Carnival Bar remained silent.
target: Tota “Carnival Bar” silentium retinuit.

source: Everyone could feel the danger in those crimson-white fireballs.
target: Omnes periculum in illis globulis ignis rubro-albo sentire poterant.

source: Lumian stopped provoking them, pointing to a chair a few meters behind him.
target: Lumian eos provocare desiit, et ad sellam paucos passus post se indicavit.

source: “Don’t appear behind me.
target: “Noli apparere post me.

source: “Don’t think about using the crowd to get close and assassinate me.
target: Ne cogites turmam ad propinquandum et ad me caedendum adhibere.

source: “If anyone crosses that chair, I’ll kill them.”
target: Si quis illam sellam transgressus fuerit, eos occidam.

source: After speaking, Lumian turned back, smiling at the bartender amid the fireballs.
target: Post locutum, Lumian se convertit retrorsum, inter globulos ignis tabernario subridente.

source: “Now, you can answer my question.”
target: “Nunc, quaestionem meam responde.”

source: Seeing this adventurer not introduce himself or boast about his exploits, but show absolute confidence and a nonchalant attitude toward killing, the bartender forced a smile.
target: Videns hunc viatorem, qui neque se introducere neque de suis factis gloriari conabatur, sed absolutam confidentiam ac indifferens modum ad caedem ostendere videbatur, tabernarius subridente respondit.

source: “We know about the same as the wanted posters.
target: “Scimus idem, quod tabulae quaesitae ostendunt.

source: If you want more hidden details, ask the enemies of the Pirate Admirals.
target: Si plura occulta velis, hostes Admiralium Piraticorum interroga.

source: Emperor Roselle once said the person who knows you best is your enemy.”
target: Imperator Roselle olim dixit: “Qui te optime novit, hostis tuus est.”

source: “Tell me about each Pirate Admiral’s enemies,” Lumian said, taking another sip of his Lanti Proof.
target: “Dic mihi de inimicis singulorum Admiralium Piraticorum,” inquit Lumian, iterum ex Lanti Proof sorbos cepens.

source: In the bar, the pirates resumed their conversations, while some quietly left, seemingly to find help upon seeing the adventurer easily maintain the fireballs.
target: In taberna piratae colloquia sua renovaverunt, dum nonnulli tacite abiissent, quasi auxilium petere inciti, cum viatorem globulos ignis facile retinere videbantur.

source: Lumian didn’t stop them or even look their way.
target: Lumian eos non prohibuit nec ad eos spectare attendit.

source: When the bartender finished, Lumian had a general understanding of who Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine’s enemies were.
target: Cum tabernarius finem pervenisset, Lumian generalem intelligentiam de inimicis Admiralis Deep Sea Howl Constantine habebat.

source: This Pirate Admiral with sea monster blood was usually low-key and mysterious.
target: Hic Admiralis Piraticus, qui sanguinem monstri marini haberet, solet esse humilis et arcanus.

source: Besides doing pirate work in a bloody and brutal manner, he rarely clashed with other Pirate Admirals or major forces.
target: Praeterquam operam piraticam cruento et crudeli modo peragendo, raro cum aliis Admiralibus Piraticis vel viribus maximis pugnavit.

source: However, the former Vice Admiral Dusk, now the King of Dusk, Bulatov Ivan, suspected Howl Constantine’s two "submarine ships" came from a legendary sea treasure, the Lost Newins.
target: Attamen, pristinus Vice-Admiralis Dusk, nunc Rex Dusk, Bulatov Ivan, suspicabatur duas “naves subaquaneas” Howl Constantine ex thesauro marino legendaro, “Newins Perditis,” ortas esse.

source: He targeted Admiral Deep Sea, seeking information on the Newins, leading to multiple conflicts.
target: Ipse Admiralem Deep Sea petivit, quaerens de Newins notitiam, quod multos conflictus attulit.

source: When Bulatov became a king over the seas, Admiral Deep Sea Howl Constantine had no choice but to avoid this powerhouse and his fleet.
target: Cum Bulatov rex super maria factus esset, Admiralis Deep Sea Howl Constantine nullo alio modo nisi hanc potentiam ac classem eius vitare oportuit.
